verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Azure REST APIs have client libraries providing a 'native interface' and describe app registration for secured REST requests, implying official SDKs exist, but the pack never names specific language SDKs, shows install/quickstart snippets, or offers independent corroboration of SDK quality. missing for 10: named SDK repos/languages (e.g. Python, .NET, Java, JS), code quickstarts, versioning/release cadence info, and hands-on developer corroboration.
